title: linux-admin 1.18.16 — NFS and Samba consolidated into storage
summary: Top-level skill count is now 70. The former nfs-expert and samba-expert are retired after their export/share, identity-mapping, permission, safe-change and validation guidance was preserved and expanded in storage/chunks/nfs.md and storage/chunks/samba.md. Multipath and backup/restore remain separate because their path-failover and recovery semantics still justify distinct specialists. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
